name: Ja & Masha
source:
The game is a DLC to the main game "[url=/v41181]Postupivshij v PTUTI[/url]". In the novel, you will spend time with your girlfriend Masha. You will play games together, explore rooms, discuss topics, look for something to eat, etc.

[translated from [url=https://muranof.itch.io/memasha]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作是本篇游戏《[url=/v41181]考入PTUTI的新生[/url]》的DLC扩展内容。在这部视觉小说中，你将与女友玛莎共度温馨时光：一起打游戏、探索房间、畅聊话题、找点好吃的填肚子等等。

[译自[url=https://muranof.itch.io/memasha]itch.io[/url]]
